notes: New file entries in the right click menu, on the desktop and in any Finder window.
Add and remove your own file types. Remove them all and the menu goes back to looking untouched.
Search your file types by name or by extension.
Choose where the menu appears: everywhere, or only in folders you pick.
Write your file types out to a file, and bring them back in.
Opens at login, lives in the menu bar, and shows in the dock only while its window is open.
